detail.longDescription: UPTIME HERALD 1.0.1 RELEASED Uptime Herald 1.0.1 is now available. This release makes it easier to build from a clone of the repository and tightens the validation of several settings. Full details are available at the link below. https:// news.uptimeherald.org/uptime-h erald-1-0-1-released # selfhosted # opensource # homelab # docker # foss # uptimeherald
